description: Na₃Mo₂N₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.93 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four N atoms. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing MoN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-N bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.97 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing MoN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-N bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.94 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Na and one Mo atom to form distorted NNa₄Mo trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NNa₄Mo trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent NNa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NNa₄Mo trigonal bipyramid. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded to two Na and two Mo atoms to form distorted NNa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NNa₄Mo trigonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one NNa₂Mo₂ trigonal pyramid.
